sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 320. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frail for 40 seconds with a success value of 80.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Insanity for 40 seconds with a success value of 90.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 100 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge gains by 3 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 50 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 100 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases your status ailment success value by 30 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 17000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 3 for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 17000

[Wicked Smile] Sandalphon or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
